problems.problem: The declared editorial right rail is still incomplete: the spec's subtitle and price strings are empty, so under the two-line title the column holds only the 294px tide rule at y=1000 and then ~430px of bare nacre to the canvas bottom. References 1 and 4 sustain their rails with logo, title, descriptor and footer lines in stepped weights; here the column reads as a floating fragment, and the logo-to-title gap (baseline 626 to title top 720, ~94px) versus title-bottom-to-rule gap (~127px) leaves the rail's vertical rhythm uneven.

The contact detail crop (base_y 1237) confirms genuine contact and offset_y 0 must stay, but the shadow renders as a thin uniform dark bar with abruptly squared ends protruding past the disc rim on both sides, sitting ON the shell ground instead of sinking into the inlay joints; there is no broader soft ambient occlusion pooling under the heavy double disc, unlike the grounded bottles in references 2 and 4.

The regenerated nacre is correctly calm and high-key on the right half (previous sparkle clusters behind the title are gone), but the wall-to-ground horizon at ~y 1105 is a very faint tonal step with almost no value separation, so the 'continuous matching nacre ground' reads as ambiguous depth behind the bottle rather than a resolved tabletop plane; the ground also shows slightly mottled swirl patches near the lower-left corner that pull attention from the contact point.

Against references 1 and 4 the poster still lacks a closing footer element and a descriptor line, and the title block's optical weight (74px two-line Arial Narrow) is light relative to the 52%-height hero disc, so the eye settles on the product and drifts off the calm right field instead of being held by a stepped typographic hierarchy.

changes.value: Mother-of-pearl shell inlay wall in cool pale blue-grey with fine matte nacre flakes in a slow low-contrast swirl, meeting a continuous matching nacre shell ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame, ground plane a half-step deeper cool grey value than the wall so the plane change reads clearly, very subdued iridescent sheen, smooth even value across the right half and across the foreground ground with no sparkle clusters and no mottled patches near the lower corners, soft high-key diffuse illumination, matte shell grain, no objects
